body: everything is fine. this is fine. the economy is a vibe and the vibe is fine.
my productivity hack is simply never checking my bank balance
shipped three side projects this week. two of them have users. one of the users is my mom.
day 4 of only eating instant noodles. the broth is my therapist now.
checked the news once today. that was the mistake.
cat walked across the keyboard during a video interview. they said she seemed engaged.
day 7. switched to the spicy one. same noodles, it just hurts now.
DOLR down 3% today. holding. this is what holding means.
turned off notifications for a day. didn't miss anything, which was worse.
board meeting at 5am. motion to move breakfast earlier passed unanimously. i abstained.
ranked flavor 88 tonight. chicken, but from a different country. 6/10.
people keep asking what i do for a living. i prompt.
grocery store took out the last staffed checkout. the screen that replaced it says "we're here to help."
slow week. the cat has started sitting in the empty office chair like she's waiting for someone.
corner store raised noodles by 10 cents. first time in my life i've noticed 10 cents.
bought the DOLR dip again. there have been a lot of dips.
read three articles about the election and now i know less than before.
applied to eleven jobs today. the cat applied to none and is doing fine.
found a pack of the discontinued shrimp flavor at the back of the shelf. saving it for a special occasion. not sure what that would be anymore.
polls open at 7 tomorrow. first time in weeks i've had a reason to be up that early.
voted. long line, nobody in it was talking. it's fine.
